# Locvel governance

Locvel is a small open-source organisation. This page describes how it runs today. It will grow when the contributor base grows.

## Decisions

The owner (aashish254) decides. Decisions happen by review and approval on the pull request or issue thread. There is no voting rule at this size.

## Architecture

Bigger decisions are recorded as append-only Architecture Decision Records in `locvel/.github/docs/adr/`.

## Membership

There is no progression path yet. Membership is private by default. When a second person contributes regularly, a maintainer path will be written here.

## If the owner is unavailable

The organisation pauses. There is no silent handover.

## Contact

Conduct issues: hello.locvel@gmail.com. Security issues: see SECURITY.md.
